title: The Wizard of Oz · 4. The Emerald City
source: Retold from L. Frank Baum, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900), public domain. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/55

text: At last they saw a green glow in the sky. It was the Emerald City, sparkling with jewels.
Everyone who went inside had to wear green spectacles.
In the throne room floated a huge head with no body.
"I am Oz, the Great and Terrible," it boomed. "Why do you come to me?"
pages.alt: A huge floating head speaks in the throne room

text: Each friend asked for a wish.
"First you must stop the Wicked Witch of the West," said Oz. "Then I will help you."
pages.alt: Each friend asks the Wizard for a wish

text: The Wicked Witch captured them, but brave Dorothy never gave up.
When the angry witch grabbed one silver shoe, Dorothy threw a bucket of water at her, and the witch melted away!
pages.alt: Dorothy throws water and the Wicked Witch melts away

text: Back in the throne room, Toto knocked over a screen in the corner.
Behind it stood a little old man. The great Wizard was just a man from Omaha!
pages.alt: Toto knocks over the screen and finds a little old man

text: "I am not a real wizard," he said, "but I can still help."
He gave the Scarecrow brains made of bran, the Tin Woodman a silk heart, and the Lion a drink of courage.
pages.alt: The Wizard gives each friend a gift

text: The Wizard made a big balloon to fly Dorothy home.
But Toto ran after a kitten, and the balloon floated away without them!
pages.alt: The balloon floats away without Dorothy

text: Then the good witch Glinda told Dorothy a secret.
"Your silver shoes can take you anywhere. Just click your heels three times and say where you want to go."
pages.alt: Glinda tells Dorothy the secret of the silver shoes

text: Dorothy hugged her friends goodbye, clicked her heels, and said, "Take me home to Aunt Em!"
In a moment she was rolling on the Kansas grass, and Aunt Em came running. "I'm so glad to be home again!" said Dorothy. The End.
pages.alt: Dorothy is home in Kansas and Aunt Em runs to hug her

questions.ask: Who was hiding behind the screen?
